question: Who was appointed as the Chairperson of the 23rd Law Commission of India in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice (Retd.) Dinesh Maheshwari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Justice (Retd.) Dinesh Maheshwari** was appointed as the Chairperson of the **23rd Law Commission of India** in **April 2025**.
 
• The **Law Commission of India** is a statutory body that advises the government on legal reforms and improvements in laws.
 
• Justice Mah
